collection.description: A village performance features temporary face paint, but a visitor mistakes it for a sacred mark.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A village performance features temporary face paint, but (visitor), a visitor, mistakes it for a sacred mark.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (artist) clarifies that the marks are fictional stage designs.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (visitor) asks thoughtful questions about local customs.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Guests paint their hands with permission.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group avoids copying restricted motifs from another people.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (artist), a performer, revises a design after hearing its unintended resemblance.

d2__fx.name: Outcome D2
d2__fx.text: Rain washes the designs away amid laughter.
